audit.why: Tricky but Taliyah-favored at range (53.48% WR, 1825 games): his whole kit needs to reach her, her E mines stun his E dash, and range denies his W healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Sylas/Skill/Sylas while content win[] and the packet both say Taliyah everywhere except a Skill row at 3.
audit.why: Content and packet agree; the content whys already explain why Taliyah holds 6 and late (his R steals mobility, not a duel win; range denies the W heal). Full sides moved to match, whys rewritten, phases[4].rating softened.
audit.corrected: Sides set to Taliyah on rows 0,1,3,4,5,6; row 2 left Skill where the layers already agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere (packet defect confirmed by lint); anti-heal vs Kingslayer flagged missing; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted trade strings.
audit.why: Sylas E (Abscond/Abduct) is 13s at rank 1 and it is his only way in — and dashing through Taliyah's E mines stuns him. Hijack runs 80/55/30s. His W heals only on champions at 400 range, so trading from 1000-range Q denies it and Ignite cuts what lands.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with digits and the E-mine-vs-dash interaction; Ignite framed as anti-heal; bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Sylas wins by landing both Chain Lash hits, dashing in with Abduct, and chaining Kingslayer heals through your burst.

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: Q on fresh ground outranges his Chain Lash whip — poke him off every last-hit before his kit has any way to reach you.

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: W online: shove him off you if he ever lunges in — Kingslayer needs 400 range and your W resets him out of it.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke every wave and E-detonate his 13s dash if he gap-closes. Range is your whole edge.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: His Hijack steals Weaver's Wall for mobility, not a duel win — hold spacing and E-detonate the dash; you keep the lane.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Luden's spike: Q chunks him before he can E in — if he dashes without an exit wave, E-detonate and burst him down.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late your range denies his Kingslayer heal entirely — trade from distance, wall his engage, and win the poke war outright.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Seismic Shove is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Abscond/Abduct (13s rank 1): his only way in — punish hard while it's down, and your E mines stun the dash itself. - Hijack runs 80/55/30s — once your stolen wall is burned he has no ult for a minute-plus. - Your W (14s) is the lifeline.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: The moment he E-dashes or W-lunges in, W-shove him straight back out — mid-dash displacement wastes the whole engage and his passive chains whiff with it.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: Melee range is where Kingslayer heals him and Petricite Burst chains hit — with no W to shove him off, you lose it.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP feeds the roam plan and wins the reset war; Ignite cuts his Kingslayer healing in the all-in. Pick by intent.
